title: Images and files
lead: Browse, upload and organize public or private files without a database.

sections.title: Choose the repository and folder
steps: Open Images → Overview and select Public or Private. Public files can be served by the site; private downloads require an authenticated administrative session.
Expand the directory tree and select a folder. Use breadcrumbs or Up to navigate. Create a folder when a separate collection is needed.
To change repository roots, use Global Settings. Changes do not relocate files. Plugin Settings controls upload subdirectories and browser page size; paths must remain inside the allowed roots.

sections.title: Find and inspect files
steps: Switch between list and grid. Grid shows image/video thumbnails or file-type icons.
Enter a search term, filter by type and choose sorting. In list view, click Name, Type, Size or Added on to toggle sorting direction. Use pagination to inspect further results.
Select an item to enable its applicable actions. Open Preview or Information to inspect it; older files may have no recorded addition date.

sections.title: Upload, download and organize
steps: Choose the destination folder, use Upload or drag permitted files into the explorer. Observe the displayed type and size limits; file contents are validated as well as extensions.
Select a file and use Download, Rename or Move. The right-click context menu provides the applicable operations as well as the toolbar; keyboard users can use the action buttons.
For example, upload a public banner, rename it to an identifiable filename and use its public address in an editor. Uploading alone does not insert it into a page.

sections.title: Replace a file while keeping its address
steps: Select the existing file and choose Replace. Choose a replacement of the required matching type and confirm the operation.
The stored filename remains the same, so existing references keep their address. Review the replacement preview; dependent pages will use the new file.
Use this action only when the replacement is intended for every reference to that file. Use a different uploaded filename for a separate asset.

sections.title: Review operations and recover removed files
steps: Open History for recorded action descriptions and available configuration revisions. Old snapshots without an action record are labeled without inventing a filename or operation.
Use Delete to move a file to Trash. Open the final Trash sidebar item and recover the file when its original permitted destination is available.
Review a configuration revision before restoring it. Restoring configuration does not relocate media or restore every historical version of a file.

sections.title: Use media from other editors
steps: Upload assets here, then use the Core media selector in Pages, Blog or Homepage. That selector supports search, sorting, list/grid views and pagination without uploading.
A public editor can select only public media. Private media is available only to a selector whose receiving context is authorized as private.

For public layout data, use public media URLs from the selected content services. The legacy files-manager:asset service only exposes previously approved public references; no image-rights administration screen is provided.

sections.title: Search, sort and paginate the overview
body: Images keeps filesystem folders and list/grid views. Search/type controls and the shared seven-position pager apply to the current folder results. List view sorts through column headings; grid view retains its sort selector.
steps: Use the icon controls and their translated tooltips. Search, clear and ordering restart at page one; page navigation preserves the selected filters and order.

All result rows and the seven-position pager scroll together with the page. The pager follows the complete table or grid without covering any result; only wide tables scroll horizontally. Ellipsis buttons open upward menus containing earlier or later pages outside the three displayed numbers. Use the keyboard or a page button to navigate.
Read the total results, displayed range/count and page totals below the pager. Unavailable directions and empty catalogs retain disabled controls.
